messages:
jules_marketing: Q&A for the keynote will have a live demo with spikes from audience questions. Need a focused bench/rerun that simulates intermittent bursts: 0->50 RPS bursts, streaming + function-calls, quantized vs fp16, and coldstart recovery behavior. Please include per-token GPU-ms, per-request latencies, and a simple heatmap of burst impact. Wed like artifacts and a tiny sanitized prompt pack for slides by EOD Friday.

nina_runtime: Noted. Can you define burst shape? Also which models? And do you need kernel-level timings or just end-to-end?

jules_marketing: Burst shape: 30s ramp to 50 RPS, 60s sustain, then idle 2m, repeat x3. Models: open-3b-quant, open-7b-quant, open-7b-fp16. End-to-end is primary, kernel timings optional but useful. Include p50/p90/p95/p99 and per-chunk streaming p90.

mike_devex: Ill drop a minimal harness payload that produces bursts and simulates typing for streaming. Use this as CLI harness.

mike_devex: ```json
{
  "scenario":"burst",
  "ramp_seconds":30,
  "sustain_seconds":60,
  "idle_seconds":120,
  "repeats":3,
  "target_rps":50,
  "stream_chunk_ms":200,
  "function_call":true,
  "users":25
}
```

nina_runtime: Good. We'll run a smoke on both quantized variants now at low concurrency, then full burst run tomorrow morning. We'll capture perf.jsonl (per-request), metrics.csv (1s granularity), and a README with exact env (cuda/toolkit, driver). Example run command:```bash
redwood-bench --model open-7b-quant --profile burst_streaming --harness samples/burst_harness.json --out ./artifacts/3587654321 --concurrency 25
```

tess_eval: Ill prepare a 25-case function-call fidelity suite focusing on missed args and schema order. Ill also run a quick quality check on long responses during high RPS to detect coherence drops. ETA noon PT.

benchbot: Queued run rb-2026-3587654321-B targets=[open-3b-quant,open-7b-quant], profile=burst_streaming, expected=45m. Artifacts will be published to s3://redwood-bench/3587654321_B/ once complete.

nina_runtime: Well include a burst heatmap (requests/sec vs p95 latency) and a small table showing coldstart recovery time (time until p95 returns within 1.2x baseline). Also will sanitize prompts (remove names/IDs) and provide sanitized_prompts.json for slide handoff.

jules_marketing: Perfect. Please ping @jules_marketing and attach artifacts link when done. If function-call fidelity drops for quantized 7b, well note it in slide copy and fallback to 3b quant for the live demo. Thanks team! :rocket:
